dialogue.content: 相談者役をさせて頂きます。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'll be playing the role of the client. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, it's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。年齢、性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 24歳 女性
dialogue.English: 24 years old, female.

dialogue.content: 無気力
dialogue.English: Apathy.

dialogue.content: 明日仕事行きたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to work tomorrow.

dialogue.content: そうですか。今無気力で仕事に行きたくないんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So right now you're feeling apathetic and don't want to go to work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無気力の原因というのは、あるんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Do you have a sense of what might be causing this apathy?

dialogue.content: 原因、、
dialogue.English: The cause...

dialogue.content: ていうか、昨日資格試験を受けて
dialogue.English: I mean, I took a certification exam yesterday,

dialogue.content: 採点したら
dialogue.English: and when I scored it myself,

dialogue.content: どう見ても合格点に2問クリアしてない
dialogue.English: it looks like I'm two questions short of the passing score.

dialogue.content: もう人生詰んだ
dialogue.English: My life is over.

dialogue.content: 試験を受けられて自己採点したらクリアしていないと思われるんですね。
dialogue.English: So you took the exam, and after self-scoring, you believe you didn't pass.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何の試験か教えてもらってもよろしいですか。
dialogue.English: May I ask what exam it was?

dialogue.content: 保育士の試験です
dialogue.English: It's the childcare worker certification exam.

dialogue.content: そうですか。今は学生さんですか。
dialogue.English: I see. Are you a student right now?

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 保育補助の仕事しています
dialogue.English: I work as a childcare assistant.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。補助の仕事はどの位されているんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. How long have you been working as an assistant?

dialogue.content: 2年です
dialogue.English: For two years.

dialogue.content: 今回が初めての試験だったんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Was this your first time taking the exam?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自己採点でクリアしていないと思われているのは辛いですね。
dialogue.English: It must be tough thinking you didn't pass based on your self-scoring.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 今の気持ちは無気力の他に何かありますか。
dialogue.English: Besides feeling apathetic, is there anything else you're feeling right now?

dialogue.content: よくわからない
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: もう人生詰んだ
dialogue.English: My life is over.

dialogue.content: 先が見えない
dialogue.English: I can't see a way forward.

dialogue.content: 今の人生では先が見えないほどお辛いんですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds so painful that you can't see a way forward in your life right now.

dialogue.content: 人生っていうか、、
dialogue.English: I mean, not my whole life, but...

dialogue.content: 何だったのかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder what it was all for.

dialogue.content: がんばってきたのに
dialogue.English: Even though I've worked so hard.

dialogue.content: そうですか。お悩みなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. This is really weighing on you.

dialogue.content: 2年間仕事しながら勉強してきて
dialogue.English: For two years, I've been studying while working,

dialogue.content: 試験に受かれば保育士になれて
dialogue.English: if I passed the exam, I could have become a childcare worker,

dialogue.content: お給料もあがったのに
dialogue.English: and my salary would have gone up, too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それほど努力をされてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've put in so much effort.

dialogue.content: 子どもが好きで、工作したり遊んだりするのが好きだから
dialogue.English: It's because I love children, and I like doing crafts and playing with them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても素晴らしいことですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 試験というのは、年に一度くらいしかないのですか。
dialogue.English: Is the exam only held about once a year?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ただ
dialogue.English: However,

dialogue.content: 前期と後期があって
dialogue.English: there's a first half and a second half of the year,

dialogue.content: 科目別合格制度があるので
dialogue.English: and there's a system where you can pass subject by subject.

dialogue.content: でももうどうしていいかわからない
dialogue.English: but I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.content: それは、お辛いですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: うーん、つらいというか
dialogue.English: Hmm, it's not just that it's difficult...

dialogue.content: 先が見えない
dialogue.English: I can't see a way forward.

dialogue.content: 不安なんですね。
dialogue.English: You're feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 科目別合格制度というのはどういうものですか。
dialogue.English: Could you explain what the subject-by-subject passing system is?

dialogue.content: 試験範囲が膨大なので
dialogue.English: Because the exam covers such a vast range,

dialogue.content: 科目別に合格したものは
dialogue.English: the subjects you pass

dialogue.content: 蓄積していく
dialogue.English: carry over,

dialogue.content: 次回にも
dialogue.English: to the next time.

dialogue.content: でももうお金がきつい
dialogue.English: But money is really tight now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お金もだいぶかかるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It costs quite a bit of money, too.

dialogue.content: 試験対策で専門学校も行ったり
dialogue.English: I even went to a vocational school for exam prep,

dialogue.content: もともと保育補助の給料が低いし
dialogue.English: and the pay for a childcare assistant is low to begin with,

dialogue.content: 一人暮らしだから
dialogue.English: and I live alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。専門学校にも行ってらしたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You even went to a vocational school.

dialogue.content: 前の仕事でためたお金を払って
dialogue.English: I paid for it with money I saved from my previous job.

dialogue.content: 行きました
dialogue.English: I went.

dialogue.content: 週末だけ
dialogue.English: Only on weekends.

dialogue.content: そうですか、すごく努力されてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, you've worked incredibly hard.

dialogue.content: 保育士になりたかったから
dialogue.English: Because I wanted to become a childcare worker.

dialogue.content: 保育士になりたいと思う気持ちが強いんですね。
dialogue.English: You have a strong desire to become a childcare worker.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今のお給料では、今後の試験対応も難しいんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: With your current salary, will it be difficult to keep preparing for future exams?

dialogue.content: はい、厳しいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's tough.

dialogue.content: そうですか。それはお困りですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That puts you in a difficult position.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 実家も大変だし
dialogue.English: My family has their own problems,

dialogue.content: あてにできない
dialogue.English: so I can't rely on them.

dialogue.content: 試験の結果というのは,いつ頃出るんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When do the official exam results come out?

dialogue.content: ひと月後ぐらい
dialogue.English: In about a month.

dialogue.content: そうですか。今は自己採点で足りないと思われていますが試験結果が出なくても厳しいと思われているんですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So, based on your self-scoring, you feel the situation is tough, even before the official results are out, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 今の気持ちでは、明日から仕事に行く気がでないんですよね。
dialogue.English: And feeling this way, you don't feel like going to work tomorrow, right?

dialogue.content: だから相談に来ました
dialogue.English: That's why I came for counseling.

dialogue.content: また、試験は１年後になってしまうんですかね。
dialogue.English: And the next chance to take the exam would be a year from now?

dialogue.content: もう仕方ないです
dialogue.English: There's nothing I can do about it now.

dialogue.content: 勉強量が足りなかったし
dialogue.English: I didn't study enough,

dialogue.content: 仕事しながら勉強はきつかったけど
dialogue.English: Studying while working was tough, but...

dialogue.content: 言い訳になるから
dialogue.English: that's just an excuse.

dialogue.content: そうですか。仕事しながらの勉強はきつかったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Studying while working must have been really tough.

dialogue.content: だってたくさんの子どもたちを見て
dialogue.English: Because I look after so many children,

dialogue.content: 今だとコロナ禍で
dialogue.English: and with COVID these days,

dialogue.content: 消毒したり大変で
dialogue.English: all the disinfecting and everything is a lot,

dialogue.content: 毎日ヘトヘトですよ
dialogue.English: and I'm exhausted every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そんなに疲れても、その後勉強されていたというのは、すごく大変でしたね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It must have been incredibly difficult to study after being so tired from work.

dialogue.content: 何か疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm just feeling tired.

dialogue.content: 話していてもつらくなるから
dialogue.English: It's becoming painful to even talk about it.

dialogue.content: 保育士になるのは、大きな夢なんですよね。
dialogue.English: Becoming a childcare worker is a big dream of yours, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですけど
dialogue.English: It is, but...

dialogue.content: 話してるのがしんどいので
dialogue.English: it's getting hard to talk about this,

dialogue.content: 終わりにしてもいいですか
dialogue.English: so is it okay if we end here?

dialogue.content: わかりました。あなたの相談にちゃんと答えられなくてすみませんでした。
dialogue.English: I understand. I'm sorry I couldn't properly address your concerns.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お話を聞かせていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: これで終わりにさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: We will end the session here.
